notes: Chance is 1% per 1% missing Health; rule.chance records the per-percent value.

name: Surrender to Madness
text: Target is afflicted with Confused and Cursed.

name: Tectonic Upheaval
text: Enemies take a massive amount of damage, lose a massive amount of defense and speed, and are afflicted with Snared. This spell is an Ultimate Spell.

name: Terror
text: Target loses a large amount of defense and is afflicted with Feared.

name: Thoughts and Prayers
text: This spell casts three additional times, but doesn't do anything.
notes: Casts three additional times, with no other effect.

name: Time Stop
text: Proceed to the next creature's turn on the Timeline, ignoring all subsequent effects as a result of casting this spell.

params.effect: proceed to the next creature's turn, ignoring subsequent cast effects

name: Timely Demise
text: Enemies take a small amount of damage. The damage is increased based on the duration of the current battle.

params.increasedBy: the duration of the current battle

name: Timewalk
text: Target executes its start-of-turn effects and increases the number of turns it has taken by 1. This spell can only ever target 1 creature and can only be cast once at a time.
notes: Can only target 1 creature; can only be Cast once at a time. Turn-count bookkeeping has no verb; other is honest here.

name: Tornado
text: Target takes a large amount of damage, plus 35% damage for each dead creature.

params.per: dead creature

name: Torun Attunement
text: Caster gains 1 stack of Torun Junior.

name: Total Carnage
text: Enemies are afflicted with Bleeding and this creature attacks each enemy. This spell is an Ultimate Spell.

name: Toxic Frogmania
text: Target takes a small amount of damage, or a massive amount of damage if it is afflicted with Poisoned.

name: Toxic Shield
text: Target gains 20% defense for each debuff it has. Then, the target's debuffs are removed.

name: Trade Offer
text: Target gains this creature's Artifact's Trait.

name: Transcendence
text: Target gains a random trait that belongs to a creature from its race.

params.what: a random trait from its race

name: Treasonous Mind
text: Caster's buffs are removed and this Spell Gem's owner steals 5% of the caster's highest stat. This spell cannot be cast manually, but has a 20% chance to be cast by enemies at the start of their turns.
notes: Cannot be cast manually; 20% chance to be cast by enemies at the start of their turns. The caster is an enemy, so its losses are on the enemy side.

name: True Light
text: Your creatures gain a large amount of defense, and enemies lose a large amount of defense.

name: True Magic
text: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage, plus 5% more damage for each charge each of its other Spell Gems are missing.

params.per: Charge their other Spell Gems are missing

name: Truesight
text: Enemies are no longer Invisible.

name: Tsunami
text: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage and lose a large amount of speed.

name: Ultimate Odor
text: Enemies take a small amount of damage. This damage repeats for each debuff the caster has.

params.repeats: once per debuff the caster has

name: Ultimus
text: Enemies each take a massive amount of damage continuously. After they take damage, this effect has a 50% chance to end, and then it jumps to the next enemy.

params.then: it jumps to the next enemy

name: Unbound Combustion
text: Target takes a small amount of damage. 100% of the damage is based on the caster's Maximum health instead of intelligence.

params.basis: 100% caster's Maximum Health instead of Intelligence

name: Unholy Augmentation
text: Your creatures gain Repelling.

name: Unholy Confessions
text: Your creatures gain a moderate amount of intelligence.

name: Unholy Frenzy
text: Your creatures gain Berserk.

name: Unholy Rage
text: Target's defense and speed are added to their attack and intelligence. Then, their defense and speed are set to their minimum values.

name: Universal Recall
text: The number of turns all creatures have taken in the current battle is set to 0.
notes: Turn-count bookkeeping has no verb; other is honest here.

name: Unrighteous Fire
text: Caster's health is set to 1, and enemies take damage equal to 30% of the amount of health removed.

name: Unstable Anomaly
text: Enemies take a small amount of damage multiplied by the number of times your creatures have cast a spell in the current battle. This spell is an Ultimate Spell.

magnitude.per: spell your creatures have cast this battle

name: Unstable Equilibrium
text: Your creatures' Current health is set equal to that of the target.

name: Unstable Summoning
text: Target gains a random minion.

name: Usury
text: Caster gains a small amount of attack for each turn it has taken in the current battle (up to 5 times).

name: Utopia
text: All creatures recover health equal to 100% of the amount they're missing.

name: Uzi
text: Random enemies take a small amount of damage continously. After each enemy takes damage, this spell has a 20% chance to end. This spell always deals critical damage.

name: Vaccination
text: Your creatures gain their lowest stat equal to 100% of the target's Poisoned potency.

name: Vacuum
text: Caster gains the target's trait.

name: Vampirism
text: Your creatures gain Leeching.

name: Verdant Spheres
text: The caster casts 3 of the target's Spell Gems in your favor.

name: Vertigo
text: Target is afflicted with Confused.

name: Vilify
text: Enemies are no longer defending or provoking.
notes: Action-state removal has no verb; other is honest here.

name: Virus
text: Enemies take damage equal to 2 turns of their Poisoned debuff.

params.effect: take 2 turns of their Poisoned damage

name: Vitality Explosion
text: Target takes damage equal to the amount of Maximum health it has greater than its base amount.

params.amount: Maximum Health above its base amount

name: Vivacious Vodka
text: One of your creatures is moved to the top of the Timeline. This spell can only ever target 1 creature and can only be cast once at a time. This spell is a Booze Spell.
notes: Booze Spell. Can only target 1 creature; can only be Cast once at a time.

name: Void Flare
text: If the target has been resurrected in the current battle, it is killed.

params.what: times the target has been resurrected this battle

name: Volatile Strike
text: Target takes a moderate amount of damage. This damage is mitigated by the target's lowest stat. 100% of the damage dealt is based on the caster's highest stat instead of intelligence.

params.basis: 100% caster's highest stat instead of Intelligence

name: Volcano
text: Enemies take a large amount of damage and are afflicted with Burning.

name: Voodoo
text: Caster takes a small, moderate, large, massive, or devastating amount of damage. Enemies take this amount of damage as well.

name: Warning
text: Your provoking creatures gain a massive amount of defense.

name: Warp Reality
text: Target's Barrier shatters, dealing damage to the target equal to 200% of the Barrier's strength.

name: Water Enchantment
text: Target gains Splashing, and a large amount of attack.

name: Waterfall
text: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage, plus 15% more damage for each creature above them on the Timeline.

magnitude.per: creature above them on the Timeline

name: Wave of Bliss
text: Enemies are afflicted with Mania. If they already have this debuff, they take damage equal to 100% of its potency instead.

name: Web
text: Target is afflicted with Snared.

name: Whiplash
text: Target takes a small amount of damage and is afflicted with Bleeding. 100% of the damage dealt is based on the caster's speed instead of intelligence.

name: Whirlwind
text: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage that ignores 30% of their defense.

name: White Magic
text: Random allies gain a random buff continuously. After each ally gains a buff, this spell has a 50% chance to end.

name: Wild Growth
text: Target gains Mending, and a large amount of Maximum health.

name: Wind Enchantment
text: Target gains Agile, and a large amount of speed.

name: Wind Shear
text: Enemies take a small amount of damage, plus 35% more damage for each Nature creature fighting on your side.

params.per: Nature creature fighting on your side

name: Windcutter
text: Enemies take a moderate amount of damage. This damage ignores the Shelled and Barrier buffs.

name: Witchcraft
text: Enemies with Cursed cast one of their single-target damage spells on a random creature.

params.spell: one of their single-target damage spells

name: Word of Chaos
text: Target has a 5% chance to be killed for each debuff it has.
notes: Chance is 5% per debuff on the target; rule.chance records the per-debuff value.

name: Words of Encouragement
text: Target recovers a small amount of health 3 times.

name: Work of Art
text: Your creatures gain an army of minions. This spell does not activate on-minion effects. This spell is an Ultimate Spell.
notes: Ultimate Spell; does not activate on-minion effects.

name: Wormhole
text: Caster swaps positions with the target on the Timeline.

params.effect: swaps positions with the target on the Timeline

name: Wormrot
text: Enemies are afflicted with Weak and Vulnerable.

name: Wrath of Nature
text: Your creatures gain a moderate amount of attack.

name: Zephyr
text: Your creatures recover a moderate amount of health, plus 25% more healing for each Life creature fighting on your side.

params.per: Life creature fighting on your side

name: Zombie Clap
text: Target takes a large amount of damage and the caster gains 3 stacks of Zombies.
